subject: Proposed addendum: SKU decommission + price protection request
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed addendum: SKU decommission + price protection request

Tom / Elena —

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, Acme is removing the legacy "GPU-XL" SKU from your order form and wants to shift committed throughput to the newer balanced SKU set. To preserve partner economics we asked for a price-protection clause for the remainder of the contract term and a one-time credit for the partially used months on the decommissioned SKU.

Attached is a first-pass addendum (Acme_Addendum_v1.docx) that: 1) lists the SKU removal and reassigns units to the balanced SKU; 2) proposes a prorated credit calculation for April-May; and 3) includes a short price-protection paragraph preventing list-rate increases for 12 months for the reassigned units.

Two asks from us to keep things moving:
- Can your procurement/legal review the attached and confirm any mandatory language for your finance team?
- If you agree in principle, can we target signature by end of next week so we can schedule the SKU migration with ops the following Monday?

I'll loop in our legal lead for a redline and we can iterate in one doc.

Thanks —
Sooj
Sooj
SoojIN Lee | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments: Acme_Addendum_v1.docx, pricing-comparison-2026Q2.csv

From: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@acmerobotics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena@acmerobotics.com>, contracts@acmerobotics.com
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed addendum: SKU decommission + price protection request

Sooj —

Thanks for sending this over. Quick notes from our side after a fast internal sync:
1) Procurement is OK with the SKU reassignment but needs the credit calculation to be explicit (start/end dates, per-SKU hourly units). Can you include a worked example?
2) Legal flagged the price-protection clause as OK but wants it limited to equivalent SKUs only, not to future model variants or emergent SKUs.
3) Finance asks that any credit be reflected on the final invoice for May rather than issued as account credit.

We can aim for next-week signature if redlines are consolidated quickly. I've included Elena and our contracts mailbox — they'll be the ones to produce redlines.

Tom
Tom Hayes | Head of Procurement, Acme Robotics
T: +1 617-555-0133

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed addendum: SKU decommission + price protection request

Sooj / team —

Thanks, this is straightforward from commercial. Two internal notes so legal has context:
- Acme's request to restrict price protection to "equivalent SKUs only" is reasonable; we should mirror that language and avoid open-ended commitments to future model types.
- If Finance will accept the credit on the May invoice we should provide a single-line credit description and the math. That avoids extra accounting tickets.

Karthik — can your pricing modeler produce the worked example referenced by Tom? Ideally a simple table: old SKU, units decommissioned, pro-rated credit amount, new SKU assignment, net delta.

Naomi — can you take a first redline pass and note any DPA/data residency or SLA callouts that would need special handling given the SKU swap will result in different regional placements?

Laura Bennett | Sr. Director, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Apr 20, 2026 at 11:05 AM Tom Hayes <t.hayes@acmerobotics.com> wrote:
> Sooj —
> 
> Thanks for sending this over....

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@acmerobotics.com>, Elena Petrova <elena@acmerobotics.com>, contracts@acmerobotics.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed addendum: SKU decommission + price protection request (redline suggestions)

Team / Tom —

I've attached an annotated redline (Acme_Addendum_redlines.pdf) with the following gating items and suggested language: 1) Price protection: limit to "existing SKU family equivalents" and add a carve-out for changes that require materially different hardware or region-specific services. 2) Credits: accept as invoice credit for May but require a clear worked example and an audit right for 90 days. 3) Data/location: if the reassigned units move workload to a different region, add a short clause requiring customer notification and an election window if their regulatory posture is impacted. 4) SLA and credits: preserve existing SLA terms but add a one-time proportional credit if the migration exceeds the agreed operational cutover window. 5) Termination right: do not add a termination for convenience; offer a narrow termination right for material non-delivery of reassigned capacity for >30 days.

If Acme agrees to the above, legal can sign the redline quickly. Two asks from my side: please confirm whether the reassignment will cause any KV cache or model-variant incompatibilities (Tech ops / Karthik) and whether finance prefers a single line-item credit or a schedule of adjustments (Laura).

Naomi Feldman | Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com

Attachments: Acme_Addendum_redlines.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <t.hayes@acmerobotics.com>, Elena Petrova <elena@acmerobotics.com>, contracts@acmerobotics.com
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed addendum: SKU decommission + price protection request — next steps and timing

Thanks everyone —

Appreciate the quick review, Tom / Elena. Next steps to keep the timeline for a May 1 migration:
1) Karthik will send a worked example and the per-SKU math by Thursday EOD (will attach the CSV).
2) Naomi will post the annotated redline into the DocuSign envelope and we will consolidate changes in one document.
3) Acme to confirm whether Finance prefers the May invoice credit (Tom) or a separate account credit (Elena) by Friday COB.
4) Ops implications: Karthik to confirm if any KV-cache/model-variant risk exists; if so we will schedule a 1-hour technical runbook call on Monday.

If Acme signs off on the gating language Naomi proposed we can finalize and send for signature next Tuesday so your PMO can plan the implementation window. We will keep the price-protection limited to equivalent SKU families and add the notification/election language for region moves.

Can you confirm the preferred credit mechanism by Friday? If yes, we'll aim to lock the final addendum and DocuSign link the same day.

Thanks —
Sooj
